column1: # Namespace capture at a macro-expanded call site (found by the variation
# sweep re-bucketing after the NUR038 wrapper retirement; successor to the
# graduated "closure captures a runtime-minted value" bucket). A fn body
# that imports a module IN ITS OWN SCOPE makes the bound namespace a
# body-local def, so an inner fn (`calc`) CAPTURES it. The retired
# Ideal/ModuleExport wrapper had no compile identity, so the unit refused
# at capture-slot numbering; the plain facet-carrying namespace Map is
# parse-minted with an ID, so the same program now refuses one stage
# later, at capture operand resolution in the macro-expanded `parse` call
# unreachable at a call site") — the namespace holds fn values and a live
# sub-registry, so there is no bakeable operand home. It refuses; the
# interpreter owns the shape. Full graduation = a capture-slot lowering
# that materialises the namespace binding at the call site.

def zzvfn fn [[] [] [import "boru:parselang"  import "boru:string-util"  def calc (fn [[source:Any opts:Map] [List] [StringUtil.split ' ' (ParseLang.source source)]])  end  (parse calc {trace:true} 'x + y') get 1]] zzvfn
